newsitem.title: FRANCE: French health fund in cost-saving deal.
newsitem.headline: French health fund in cost-saving deal.

text.p: The French CNAMTS health insurance fund said it had concluded a deal with an association of specialist doctors about the classification of medical acts which could save 500 million francs per year from 1997.
The deal, reached on October 28, follows earlier proposals made on September 10 at the request of the Health and Social Affairs Ministry.

Th CNAMTS said the application of the classification could "lead to a savings trend of about 500 million francs per year from 1997, or a saving of around two percent in the specialist areas concerned.
